definitions.explanation: The yellowish-white fluid that forms at the site of an infection, consisting of dead white blood cells, bacteria, and tissue debris.
Used figuratively to refer to deep-seated corruption, problems, or dysfunction within an organization or system that needs to be exposed and dealt with.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{膿|うみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Pus is coming out of the wound.

examples.japanese: {膿|うみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}した→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I disinfected it after draining the pus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯茎|はぐき}→歯茎：05025_haguki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れて→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧{膿|うみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My gums were swollen and pus had accumulated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膿|うみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し{切|き}る→出し切る：30155_dashikiru⟧。
examples.english: To root out all the corruption in the organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膿|うみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Reforms that root out years of accumulated rot are needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膿|うみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: Triggered by the scandal, the company's deep-seated corruption was exposed one after another.

notes:
A basic medical term that is also widely used as a powerful metaphor for corruption and systemic problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膿|うみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: pus comes out
- {膿|うみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to drain pus; to root out corruption
- {膿|うみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる: pus accumulates; problems fester
- {膿|うみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し{切|き}る→出し切る：30155_dashikiru⟧: to completely drain the pus/corruption

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea, ocean), which has the same pronunciation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{化膿|かのう}→化膿：15315_kanou⟧: suppuration, festering — the medical process of pus formation
- ⟦{腐敗|ふはい}→腐敗：07997_fuhai⟧: corruption, decay — used figuratively for organizational corruption
